about: Vectors for mpp/charge/lcp/hedera (profile mpp/method/lcp, rules 12 to 21). H is SHA-256("abc") from FIPS 180-2. Every body and signed transaction was built and frozen with hiero-sdk-python 0.2.10's TransferTransaction (protobuf 7.36.2, Python 3.12.3) and signed with its Ed25519 key from the seed below, by tools/hedera_bytes.py run outside the workspace on 2026-11-17 (python -I hedera_bytes.py, in a virtual environment holding hiero-sdk-python==0.2.10); a scheduled id through the SDK's TransactionId, a nonce through the SDK's own TransactionBody protobuf, a list through its TransactionList protobuf. Nothing comes from lcp's builder. build rows hold the body the SDK froze and the transaction the SDK signed for the same inputs. Each refusal row is a good transaction with one member changed, built the same way, and the function and code expected; the rows whose bytes no SDK writes (over the size bound, not a protobuf message) say so. landed rows hold the Mirror Node's recorded testnet answer of GET /api/v1/transactions/0.0.3229-1791145265-469000038 (2026-10-04), whose memo is the mirror monitor's text, and that entry with one stated edit, its memo_base64 H's LCP string. now is the clock reading validate is given, in Unix seconds.

buyer.about: The buyer gate's rows for this file's pairing, in the form of buyer.json's rows. B2 is the plant: the document advertises H, the hash of the ATR in B6's first check, and the link serves the planted ATR, that ATR with one byte changed; the gate declines hash-mismatch and never calls the signer. B6 is the pairing's bound check over the payment this file already holds: check(ATR, presented) gives H, and check(planted ATR, presented) declines signed-not-bound. The ATR is abc, H its SHA-256 (FIPS 180-2 B.1), and the planted ATR abd; SHA-256 values are Node's crypto.createHash.
